name: RDK X3
summary: RDK X3 is an Arm-based single-board computer for robot development and edge AI prototyping. Its quad-core Cortex-A53 processor and BPU support vision inference, while camera, USB, Ethernet and general-purpose I/O connections integrate sensors and control hardware. D-Robotics provides operating-system images, development tools and TogetheROS.Bot middleware for evaluating robot applications. Memory options and hardware revisions are documented within this model family.
